snippet.title: Letterally Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4124240/Letterally?utm_source=YT_TheTomorrowCommittee

Letterally blends strategic word-building with roguelike progression.
Ascend through ten increasingly difficult levels, banking spare turns in solo stages to unleash them against formidable bosses. Master board positioning to trigger Cell Modifiers, then visit the shop to craft your ultimate synergy with unlockable Totems and Tile Enhancements.
From puzzle challenges to classic duels, find new ways to spell victory!
